maintenance_led.reason: Majority of revenue is utility gas/electric master-service-agreement work: pipe replacement, repair, maintenance on existing networks, plus storm restoration; some new construction.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are regulated gas and electric utilities, paid by ratepayers (households, businesses), not government directly.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly organically through long-term utility customer contracts; acquisitions like Riggs Distler were occasional, not a steady roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: Safety- and regulation-critical gas and electric utility work, with long-standing customer relationships averaging 24 years and qualified crews.

notes: Maintenance versus new-build split is uncertain; much work is replacement and repair of existing utility networks under recurring contracts.
